title: China's AI Policy Shift: What Should Users Watch?
description:
China's AI Policy Shift: What Should Users Watch?. Does the U.S. government's push to maintain an AI edge over China justify ignoring industry warnings about the need for a development pause?

What we covered:
• Trump downplays new AI checks, saying the U.S. should not cede its edge to China
• Anthropic CEO urges slower AI development as safety risks intensify
• AP reports caution over AI risks revives long-running extinction debate
• AP says Beijing rebukes Anthropic chief’s call to curb China’s AI development
• US futures fall as AI blowback weighs on tech stocks

One lead story. The other headlines are supporting evidence, complications, or counterexamples.

Listener question: Does the threat of losing an AI race to China make you more or less comfortable with companies skipping safety-focused development delays?

What to watch tomorrow: not which AI headline was loudest, but which one quietly changed the rules.

Alex, Jamie and Rufus tell you what changed in AI, who wins, and what you do next.
